text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
What kind of legacy Umamusume or support 
card setup 
do you need to train a strong 
Umamusume...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To help solve that very dilemma, 
we've prepared the "Training Plan Sheet"!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's go over the Training Plan Sheet. 
This sheet has three main features.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
First is the "Goal Setting Feature." 
You can set target base stats, as well as 
the skills and sparks you want to acquire.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Second is the "Apply to Training Plan 
Feature." 
This feature supports your training 
to help keep you aligned with your set 
goals.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Third is the "Comparison Feature." 
This lets you check whether your trained 
Umamusume 
actually met the goals you set.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Now let's review each feature using a 
sample sheet. 
Let's use a "Share ID" to load an existing 
sheet!
